name: amirbabar-github-io
description: Personal website and blog for Amir Babar — Quartz static site

scripts.setup: cd source && npm ci && node quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs plugin install
scripts.build: cd source && node quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs build -o public && mv public/index public/index.html
scripts.serve: cd source && node quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs build -o public --serve
